mapper.sql: select product_id, product_code, product_name, category, cast(degrees as text) as degrees, cast(countries as text) as countries, description, price_min, price_max, currency, price_note, bookable, duration_minutes, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from abr_product
mapper.insert: insert into abr_product (product_code, product_name, category, degrees, countries, description, price_min, price_max, currency, price_note, bookable, duration_minutes, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{productCode}, #{productName}, #{category}, cast(#{degrees} as jsonb), cast(#{countries} as jsonb), coalesce(#{description}, ''), #{priceMin}, #{priceMax}, coalesce(#{currency}, 'CNY'), coalesce(#{priceNote}, ''), #{bookable}, #{durationMinutes}, coalesce(#{sortOrder}, 0), #{status}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from abr_product where product_id in #{productId}
mapper.select: select (select count(*) from abr_booking where product_code = #{productCode}) + (select count(*) from abr_order where product_code = #{productCode}) + (select count(*) from abr_moment_rule where recommend_product = #{productCode}) + (select count(*) from abr_playbook where products @> jsonb_build_array(cast(#{productCode} as text)))
